summary: Emptied resourceWritePaths so 'import stats' fails honestly instead of POSTing records at the /stats QUERY endpoint and reporting phantom imports.
reason: Greptile P1 on publish PR #1667: the generator classified the spec's only POST endpoint (a query engine) as a writable import target. The whole API is read-only. Generator retro candidate: POST-with-response-array query endpoints should not enter resourceWritePaths.
validated_outcome: import stats --input x.jsonl now exits 2 with 'unknown writable resource'; go build and tests pass.
